decided: When a sensor set to halt fires, orbit writes the stop and prints one line naming it as the step finishes; orbit asks the question itself only where a run the user let continue on its own would stop, as it does for any open stop. In a session the user is running step by step, nothing else asks it, and the user finds the open stop in the brief.
alternatives: Add text to every workflow so the AI asks the stop's question at once whenever a sensor halts.
Print nothing and rely on the brief alone.
why: Text added to every workflow changes what the AI does, which G0 and R-adf-12 allow only behind a setting, and this change edits no workflow; one printed line costs nothing when no sensor is set to halt, since none is by default.
detail: The emit surface writes one stderr line per tripwire stop it writes; the chain's open-stop row prints the stop's question when a chain is granted (design M4, Risks).
